about: Assertions written by this repository (aeoess), not by the anchor pointer draft or its author. They pin output fields that the draft 1.1 vectors leave unpinned, where the draft 1.1 README rule fixes the value. Each value was worked out by hand from the vector inputs and the rule quoted in `rule`, not copied from reader output. vectors/vectors.json is unchanged.
